text.en: This Order may be cited as the Miscellaneous Licences Act (Amendment) of section 2 Of Chapter 127.

Section 2 of the Miscellaneous Licences Act, in this Order referred to as the (a} in subsection (1), by deleting "It shall be lawful for His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council by regulations" from the first two by substituting "The Minister, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, may by regulations" therefor

(b) in subsection (2), by deleting "His Majesty in Council" from the and by substituting "The Minister, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan,". of new section 4A.

Tpe Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after "Delegation. 4A. ( 1) A licensing authority may delegate to any public officer the exercise of any power or the performance of any duty conferred or imposed on it by this Act, except for the power of delegation conferred by this section.

(2) A delegation under subsection (1} may be made subject to such conditions as may be determined by the licensing authority in the instrument of delegation.

(3) A licensing authority may continue to exercise any power and J any duty conferred or imposed on it by this Act notwithstanding the delegation by it of such power or duty.". Made this 29th. day of Rabiulawal, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 5th. day of April, 2008 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
